home.metaTitle: analysisACE: Shariah screening and macro analytics for the DSE
home.title: See why a DSE stock passes or fails a Shariah screen
home.subtitle: analysisACE is building open, explained Shariah screening and macro analytics for the Dhaka Stock Exchange, with household finance tools for Bangladesh.

shariah.title: Shariah screen with reasons
shariah.body: Every listed company tested against published rules, shown with the company's own figures and the report they came from.

macro.title: Rates and shocks
macro.body: How each stock has historically moved when treasury bill yields changed, and how it behaved in past crises.

household.title: Household finance
household.body: Daily costs, Zakat, tax figures, net worth across shares, sukuk, deposits, gold and land, and FIRE planning.

auth.signInIntro: Welcome back. Sign in to your analysisACE account.
auth.signUpIntro: Free to join. You can delete your account at any time.
auth.acceptTerms: I agree that analysisACE may store my account details to provide this service.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. The link works for about an hour.
auth.resetIntro: You will be signed out on all devices.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.

account.title: My account
account.passwordIntro: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
account.consentsIntro: You can change these at any time. Each change is recorded with its date.

MARKETING.title: Product news by email
MARKETING.body: Occasional emails about new features. No third-party marketing.

RELIGIOUS_PREFERENCES.title: Zakat and Shariah preferences
RELIGIOUS_PREFERENCES.body: Lets analysisACE store religious preferences, such as your Zakat method and nisab basis. This is sensitive data and is used only for those features.

COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKING.title: Anonymous community comparisons
COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKING.body: Includes your figures in anonymised group averages. Nothing that identifies you is shown.

account.dataIntro: Download a copy of everything analysisACE holds about you.
account.deleteIntro: Deletes your account and all data tied to it straight away. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmBody: Enter your password to confirm. Your account and data will be removed permanently.

admin.usersIntro: Change a person's role or turn their access off. Every change is written to the audit log.

admin.rolesIntro: Roles are fixed. This table shows what each role may do.

USER.name: User
USER.description: Every registered person. Uses the public and personal features.

ANALYST.name: Analyst
ANALYST.description: Staff who review data and publish content.

ADMIN.name: Administrator
ADMIN.description: Full control, including users and rule files.

DATA_REVIEW.name: Review data
DATA_REVIEW.description: Work the data review queue and correct extracted financial figures.

CONTENT_PUBLISH.name: Publish content
CONTENT_PUBLISH.description: Publish weekly macro notes and shock events.

SHARIAH_OVERRIDE.name: Override Shariah status
SHARIAH_OVERRIDE.description: Add Shariah board notes and manual overrides with a reason.

CONFIG_MANAGE.name: Manage rules
CONFIG_MANAGE.description: Approve rule file versions and bank flags.

USERS_MANAGE.name: Manage users
USERS_MANAGE.description: See all users, change roles and turn access on or off.

AUDIT_VIEW.name: View audit log
AUDIT_VIEW.description: Read the record of admin actions.
